scheme_name: Workers for Class 9th to 12th Through National Scholarship (JKBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir
Applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
One of the student's parents must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Student must be studying in classes 9th to 12th
benefits_summary: Annual scholarship of ₹1,200 per child, up to two children.
